title: Build a Lead Intelligence App with WeWeb and BuildShip
summary: Learn how to build a lead intelligence app that analyzes company websites and provides insights for potential outreach.
body_markdown:
In this webinar, our Education Lead Matthew and Colin from BuildShip demonstrate how to build a lead generation app that analyzes company websites and provides insights for potential outreach.


Watch the full webinar here:


## Prompts & Wireframes to build the frontend


### Lead Analysis Page


#### Prompt:


*I am creating an app that lets users submit the url of a company url, then outputs a lead rating (high, med, or low), a summary of the company, and a suggested angle based on the user's business. I need you to build the page where they submit the URL and see the output. Please make sure all elements that are interactive have a cool hover state, and that the left side nav bar is a multi page section. I have attached an image of the extremely basic skeleton I want the page to be based off. Please ensure it has a minimalistic, modern design.*


#### Wireframe:


### History Page


#### Prompt:


*Great!I now need the ‘History’ page. Here I want to list all previous generations in a table with their respective info.*


*I also need to give the user the ability to search through them.*


*Please make sure all elements that are interactive have a cool hover state, and that the left side nav bar is a multi page section.*


*I have attached an image of the extremely basic skeleton I want the page to be based off. Please ensure it has a minimalistic, modern design.*
